title: Cypress
description: Fast, reliable end-to-end testing for anything that runs in a browser.

data.text: Cypress is an end-to-end testing framework that runs directly in the browser. It provides time-travel debugging, automatic waiting, and a GUI for inspecting test runs.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install Cypress as a dev dependency.
data.code:
npm install --save-dev cypress
# or
yarn add --dev cypress

data.title: Basic E2E Test
data.content: Write an end-to-end test with Cypress.

data.title: Open Mode
data.text: Run npx cypress open to launch the interactive Cypress GUI for writing and debugging tests.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Cypress runs tests in the same run loop as the app
data.takeaway: Cypress is the leading choice for reliable end-to-end browser testing.
